One of the executive orders Trump signed this past week seeks policy recommendations to expand access to in vitro fertilization.
According to a 2024 survey, 1 in 10 women of reproductive age say they received fertility assistance, including IVF, but insurance coverage for the procedure is limited.
Ali Rogin speaks with Barbara Collura about how the order stacks up to Trump’s campaign pledge.
